mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT B.REG_CODE id, B.REG_CODE text FROM CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE B where B.REG_CODE is not null order by B.REG_CODE
SELECT A.REG_CODE regCode, A.ORG_CODE orgCode, A.PRODID prodId, A.PRODNAME prodname FROM CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE A INNER JOIN CHB_EQUDET_IMP_TMP B ON A.ORG_CODE = B.ORG_CODE AND A.PRODID = B.ACCOUNT
SELECT * FROM CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE B where B.PRODID = #{prodid}

SELECT count(1) from CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE where PRODID = #{prodid}
and ORG_CODE = #{orgCode}

SELECT DISTINCT A.REG_CODE id, ifnull(b.prod_name,a.reg_code) text FROM CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE A left join chb_prd_baseinfo b on b.prod_id = a.PRODID
A.REG_CODE is not null
and A.REG_CODE like concat_ws('','%', #{search},'%') or b.PROD_NAME like concat_ws('','%', #{search},'%')
#{orgCode}
ORDER BY A.REG_CODE
select PRODID prodId , REG_CODE regCode from CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE

select PRODID prodId,REG_CODE regCode from CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE
1=1
and PRODID = #{prodid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
order by update_time desc

SELECT p.prod_id,p.prod_name FROM chb_prd_baseinfo p where p.status in ('E','M') and p.fprod_id is null
AND P.PROD_ID LIKE concat_ws('','%', #{search},'%')

SELECT p.PROD_INS_ID as prodInsId,p.prod_name FROM chb_prd_baseinfo p where p.status in ('E','M') and p.fprod_id is null
AND P.PROD_INS_ID LIKE concat_ws('','%', #{search},'%')
select prod_ins_id prodInsId, raise_type raiseType from chb_prd_declare_info where prod_ins_id = #{prodId}
